headlines.title: Alfalfa sprouts recalled for E. coli and salmonella after dozens of illnesses in 15 states
headlines.description: Health officials are warning consumers not to eat certain brands of alfalfa sprouts that have been linked to an unusual outbreak involving different disease-causing bacteria.

headlines.title: CDC investigates cases of salmonella and E.coli linked to alfalfa sprouts
headlines.description: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention is investigating dozens of cases of salmonella and E.coli linked to alfalfa sprouts. The cases were concentrated in the Midwest, with two people infected with both salmonella and E.coli at the same time.

headlines.title: Formula x Meredith Founder Shares Moves Focusing on Longevity
headlines.description: Former ballerina Meredith Shumway joins TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to share her viral low-impact high-intensity workout The Formula x Meredith that has a focus on longevity.

headlines.title: Hoda Kotb and Leadership Coach Neal Schore on Being a Leader
headlines.description: Hoda Kotb and her leadership coach Neal Schore join TODAY’s Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones to talk about how he helped her develop her leadership skills, and then he shares some tips from his book “The 25th Hour,” to use in businesses and relationships. Tips include pausing before speaking, taking ownership, setting your intent and more.

headlines.title: What is Cortisol and Why is It Important?
headlines.description: Most people associate cortisol with stress but it actually plays a bigger role in daily life. NBC News medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar joins TODAY to explain what cortisol is, how to know if your levels are off, how to regulate it, and more.

headlines.title: This is what you need (and need to do) to stay safe this hurricane season
headlines.description: I talked to a meteorologist to find the best way to prepare for hurricanes and what products you should have on hand.

headlines.title: The Garmin Instinct 3 is at its back at its Prime Day low — it’s $150 off
headlines.description: The latest Garmin Instinct 3 is at its lowest price ever at Amazon and Dick’s. It’s a rugged, outdoor fitness tracker with extra long battery life.

headlines.title: This is the dorm registry I wish I had as a college freshman
headlines.description: A dorm registry can help you pull together everything you need for college — including bedding, supplies and more — and give friends and family an easy way to help.

headlines.title: The best portable air conditioners to keep you cool in any space
headlines.description: These top-rated portable ACs from Black+Decker, Shinco and Midea can keep you cool in any space, and are easy to store during colder seasons.

headlines.title: Eye drops recalled over possible contamination, FDA reports
headlines.description: The FDA reported that bottles of Clear Eyes Maximum Itchy Eye Relief have been recalled over potential contamination.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: Salmonella outbreak linked to tainted jalapenos isn’t over, as CDC reports more than 400 cases
headlines.description: The CDC reported more than 400 cases in 32 states, although the number of illnesses is likely to be much higher.
